name: What's the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted bathroom vanity?

mainEntity.name: What's the difference between a freestanding and a wall-mounted bathroom vanity?

acceptedAnswer.text: Freestanding vanities sit directly on the bathroom floor, resembling a piece of furniture. They often offer more storage space and are generally easier to install, as they don't require wall reinforcement. Wall-mounted, or floating, vanities are attached directly to the wall, leaving the floor space beneath clear. This creates a more contemporary aesthetic and can make a small bathroom appear larger. However, wall-mounted vanities require secure structural support within the wall and may involve more complex installation due to plumbing alignment.
acceptedAnswer.description: Freestanding vanities sit on the floor, offering more storage and easier installation. Wall-mounted vanities attach to the wall, creating a modern look but requiring structural support.
